evidence: Provenance. phase_base_sha e5266ce1c7820be7371d73ad3dfe09447c673127, role_base_sha 5f8b26f9690de9bf2f0bfc31efc51c32c49bbf1b, audited_head_sha 5f8b26f9690de9bf2f0bfc31efc51c32c49bbf1b. git rev-parse HEAD during this audit returned the audited HEAD. The full-range diff stat holds many other-track files, but the scope paths are exactly books.json, the 16books test, files.ts, cover-picture.ts, covers.ts, and the build script. No scope file changed after the audited HEAD.

Focus 1 data contract. books.json holds 16 rows with L2U1 story weeks [1] and sounds/decodable/sight/books weeks [1-7], and L1U1 plus L4U4 with five empty week lists. covers.ts storytimeCoverPanelReadableWeeks requires a parsed week file plus a phonics-graph GPC node at the program week, and checkStorytimeCoverPanelRow fails an unreadable listed week and a readable unlisted week. The R21 test asserts the same lists and the week-8 exclusion. GREEN_TEST_COMMAND 45 passed and PROJECT_TESTS 484 passed per the orchestrator gate, so data, module, and tests agree.

Focus 1 story source. L2U1 story text Hello, I am Nan. Nan can nod. A nest, a net, a nut, a nose. with weeks [1]; checkStorytimeCoverPanelRow checks each story word against storytimeCoverStudentWords of the readable source weeks and fails a year. Week 1 is the approved week, so the story passes both the mock and the print path.

Focus 2 D11.5a word case. covers.ts storytimeCoverPanelWordCase keeps a capital only when every source-candidate occurrence has it, else lower case; the repeat check stays lower case; shown() maps decodable and sight through that table. The only caller of storytimeCoverPanelValues is the build script lines 248 and 251; no print-track module under dashboard/lib/storytime/print/ calls it. R27 asserts I, Nan, Pam, Pat, Sam, Tom and lower-case a, can, pan, tap, mom with unchanged first positions. No caller expects the old all-lower-case form.

Focus 2 D11.5b title join. covers.ts line 514 joins books with '; ' via STORYTIME_COVER_PANEL_TITLE_SEPARATOR, while sounds/decodable/sight join with ', '. Lines 497-500 stop the build with an error that names the level, unit, book title, week, and offending title when a title holds ';'. The back HTML escapes the joined string, so Tap, Tap! stays one item. R28 asserts 14 items on split('; ') with item 12 Tap, Tap! plus the stop. No caller expects the old ', ' join.

Focus 2 hand-off of panel output. The build script passes panelValues into renderStorytimeCover with panelMock !print, writes chosenPt and panelReport into build-report.json fields panel.chosenPt, panel.fields, and panel.books, and panelReport derives present/missing from the week lists and the story text rather than from display case. The D11.5 change therefore cannot flip a report state. The print-track student-book.ts never imports panel values; it only calls storytimeQrUrl for QR page paths.

Focus 3 CLI options. The script accepts --level 1-4, --unit 1-4, --out, --print, --data, --version, --help/-h; unknown options print USAGE to stderr and return 2. --help prints USAGE and returns 0. Missing or out-of-range --level/--unit returns 2. Non-integer or <1 --version returns 2. checkStorytimeCoverOutDir runs at line 221 before data load, temp files, mkdir, writes, or browser launch, and returns 2 on error.

Focus 3 CLI exits and stops. Exit 0 builds; exit 1 covers data errors, missing row, unreadable graph, the ';' title throw caught in the try block, the D12 approved-only stop at lines 249-258, picture errors, PDF/X failures, and the final catch; exit 2 covers usage errors and the output-folder stop. R29 asserts exit 2 into another version folder with the seed file unchanged; R22 asserts the D12 stop with no write. The --print build stops by design for all three books, so no v3 printer file exists.

Focus 3 USAGE versus behavior. USAGE lines 44-64 name the five output files, the version-3 default folder proof-v3/<level><unit>, the --print PDF/X path, and exit code 1 only. The code behavior matches the file names and the default folder, but USAGE omits the exit-2 paths and omits that --out is required when version is not 3. Two low nonblocking findings record those doc gaps; no behavior gap exists.

Focus 3 output files. The script writes front.png, back.png, cover.pdf, corner-mode.txt, and build-report.json into the output folder, plus the PDF/X file Storytime-Advantage-L<level>-U<unit>-Student-Book-Cover-v<version>_PDFX-1a.pdf with --print. STORYTIME_COVER_OUT_FILES names the same five fixed files. The test header and the Green plan rows name the same set.

Focus 4 hand-off rows. The Green v3/v3b plan rows record the 15 v3 files (3 books times 5 files) plus the 12 v1 and 12 v2 SHA-256 lists with equality before and after, and the Check/Hand-off rows name the Drive subset (9 files plus contact-sheet-v3b.png plus the weeks-2-8 text). The rows therefore name the files the CLI writes; the Drive message is a subset by design since corner-mode.txt and build-report.json are not Daniel checks.

Scope note. storytimeQrUrl from files.ts is not used by the cover module, the composer, or the build script; the back QR uses the fixed STORYTIME_LINE_ADDRESS through generateQRCode. No Storytime route or live QR target belongs to this phase, so there is no route parity gap. UX_REQUIRED=never holds: outputs are print files, and no browser inspection ran. I started no session named Review C.
